summary:
This run finished the digits stage after verify-digits-1. The previous attempt was cut off during its doc edits. Its builder was already on disk and matches outputs/qa/scratch/build-digits/fix/src (sha1 ed6a4b0). I checked that builder, finished the docs, added evidence for the thumb-root fold, and rebuilt and scored both hands again from the committed poses.

Fix for the verifier's major finding: `knuckle_rise` now grows the MCP knuckle as a dome from a fixed base inside the metacarpal head. The centre moves out by rise/2 and the dorsal half-axis grows by rise/2 × N_head. The old version moved a fixed ellipsoid outward, which gave a ball with a valley at 0.3 and a separate shell from 1.25. The new shape is identical at rise 0, so the committed GLBs stay byte-identical. The ranges are narrower: `knuckle_rise` −0.5–0.6, `head_back` −0.5–1.0, `phalanx_base` 0.5–1.0. Every in-range combination stays attached: 64/64 corner cases, thinnest joint 0.45 × the finger's thickness. The builder now checks review A1 itself: an `[a1]` line and an `a1` field in the mesh report. It exits with status 1 when A1 fails or on any error; before, Blender exited 0 even after an error in the script.

Minor findings:
- `nail_relief` is capped at 0.35, and the docs say where it misbehaves on digits seen side-on: the crisp outline makes a corner, and a raised relief fills out the tip.
- The docs are updated in HAND_ASSETS and CONTRACTS §5/§6: the fingertip search, the known limitations, the tip figures, and cap lengths now "× its half-thickness".
- The right thumb-root fold is still there. Tracing the field from the home camera shows why: the long cap hangs over palm that lies 0.05–0.17 world units behind it, because the pose puts the CMC at z 0.24. The fuller right palm from step 2's scratch pose keeps the fold; moving the CMC back shortens it. So it is documented, and whether to keep it is a question for the user below.

The final state is on disk: A1 and D9 pass on both hands, the build is byte-identical to HEAD and to two earlier builds, and `tsc` is clean.

items.item: 1 Knuckle prominence (left request 1), including verifier-major fix (knuckle_rise moved a fixed ball outward)
items.what: Three per-finger shape keys: head_back (the metacarpal head's centre and its knuckle sit this far behind the MCP joint, x N_head), knuckle_rise (the knuckle's top rises this far beyond the default bump, x N_head), phalanx_base (the proximal phalanx's section where it leaves the knuckle, x the MCP section; this makes the step down). knuckle_rise now GROWS the knuckle from a fixed base inside the head: Ell centre = head_c + n*N_head*(0.5 + rise/2) - t*0.15*N_head, dorsal half-axis = 0.496*N_head + rise/2*N_head. Its base stays at the head centre for every rise, so it cannot come off the hand; at rise 0 it is identical to the old bump. Ranges: knuckle_rise -0.5..0.6, head_back -0.5..1.0, phalanx_base 0.5..1.0 (every combination stays attached). A value out of range stops the build with exit 1. A GLB that fails A1 (for example more than one shell) now gives [a1] FAIL and exit 1, after all outputs are written. A pose can now keep the index MCP at its reading (592,306) and still draw the knuckle bump and the step down to the finger.

interface:
Every per-hand setting is a key in the pose file's optional top-level "shape" object. The app ignores it: `node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit` is clean. A key in DIGIT_KEYS takes either one number (all the digits it covers) or {digit: number}. The knuckle keys cover the four fingers only. An unknown key or digit, a non-finite value, or a value outside SHAPE_RANGES stops the build with a ValueError and exit status 1.

New keys, with defaults and ranges:
- `thumb_root_cap`: default 3.0, range 0.2-6. Both hands. Length of the thumb metacarpal's soft carpal cap, × its half-thickness.
- `thumb_roll_deg`: default 72, range -180..180. Per hand. The thumbnail's orientation.
- `knuckle_rise`: default 0, range -0.5..0.6. Per finger. How far the knuckle's top rises beyond the default bump, × N_head. It grows as a dome from a fixed base inside the head.
- `head_back`: default 0, range -0.5..1.0. Per finger. How far the head and knuckle sit behind the MCP joint, × N_head.
- `phalanx_base`: default 1.0, range 0.5..1.0. Per finger. The proximal phalanx's section where it leaves the knuckle, × the MCP section.
- `ip_knuckle_size`: default 0.62, range 0..2. Per digit. 0 = no dorsal PIP/DIP bump.
- `ip_knuckle_lift`: default 0.62, range 0..2. Per digit.
- `nail_relief`: default 0.12, range 0..0.35. Per digit. Plate height × the tip's half-thickness.
- `nail_outline`: default 0, range 0..1. Per digit. 0 = soft fade; 1 = crisp rounded free edge, a closed D outline.

New PARAMS global: `nail_free` 0.60, where the crisp free edge sits on the tip cap.

Values the pose files set (unchanged in this run):
- Left: thumb_roll_deg 72, nail_relief {thumb 0.2}, nail_outline {thumb 1}.
- Right: thumb_roll_deg 115, nail_relief {thumb 0.3}, nail_outline {thumb 1}, ip_knuckle_size {index 0}.

Builder output:
- The mesh report has a new `a1` field: {pass, failures}.
- The builder prints one `[a1] <hand>: ... PASS|FAIL (...)` line per hand.
- Exit status 1 when a hand fails A1 (after all outputs are written) or on any uncaught error.

decisionsForUser.question: Fixing item 5 changed the right hand in a way the requests did not ask for. The long thumb-root cap (thumb_root_cap 3) removed the proud capsule end and the groove around it, but it left a thin soft fold line along the right thumb's underside, toward the wrist. In the home view it runs x1127-1194, y725-727 and ends in a dark point about as dark as the old groove (grey 41 vs 39). In the -35 view it is a slit x704-839, y487-502. It is a soft concave valley where a thenar crease would be, not a sharp fold. The line is there because the thumb's base hangs over palm that lies 0.05-0.17 world units behind it: the pose puts the thumb CMC at z 0.24, 0.14 in front of the palm joint. Should the stage keep it?
options: A) Keep the long cap and accept the line as a thenar crease. Step 2 may shorten it by moving the right thumb CMC back in depth where the reference allows: z 0.24 -> 0.20 / 0.16 shortens it from 67 px to 43 / 20 px. The app draws only outer contours, so the line appears only in the solid shading and, on the particle hand, wherever the sampler weights grazing surfaces.

B) Another builder change now: a thenar mass that fills the depth between the thumb's base and the palm behind it, so the underside runs smoothly into the palm. This changes the thumb base in every view, may move the right hand's lower outline by a few px, and needs its own verification.
C) Go back to the short rounded cap (thumb_root_cap 1). The line goes, but the proud capsule end and its groove come back (item 5 undone). A pose can already set this per hand.
